title: encyclia adenocarpos
intro: Encyclia adenocarpos, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night," is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the genus Encyclia. This plant is known for its beautiful white flowers that bloom only at night, emitting a strong, sweet fragrance to attract pollinators. The health benefits of Encyclia adenocarpos include its potential to help lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
